# Relay FAQ

Most teams finish onboarding in two weeks. A named customer success manager is assigned to every Team workspace.

Relay connects to Slack, Zendesk and Salesforce out of the box. The public API allows 600 requests per minute per workspace.

Support is available around the clock by chat on the Team plan. Starter customers get email support on weekdays.

Migrating from another help desk is free. We import tickets, contacts and macros from Zendesk and Freshdesk.
